items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Because see he had been traveling at that time with Buddy Stewart and Kai Winding on trombone and Shelly Manne, and Lou Stein on piano, and Bob Carter on bass.

ctx.x: Okay. But they definitely wanted the two of you.

They wanted the two of us yeah. Because see he had been traveling at that time with Buddy Stewart and Kai Winding on trombone and Shelly Manne, and Lou Stein on piano, and Bob Carter on bass. And so they had Buddy singing ballads and doing some things with voice-horn things, with Charlie. And I was just the girl singer at first, for a few minutes, because he had a job at the Sherman Hotel and the College Inn and they had airtime and they wanted a girl singer. But you know something funny happened. I just recalled…
Well you confuse the issue. This is before we joined forces with Charlie.
